passages.text: By the seventh month, the Israelites had settled in their towns, and the people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
They had returned from exile.
They settled in their own towns.
The seventh month arrived.
All the people gathered together.
They came as one group.
They assembled in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּעָרִ֑יםס וַיֵּאָסְפ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his fellow priests, along with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates, began to build the altar of the God of Israel to sacrifice burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.
passages.sermon:
Jeshua was the son of Jozadak.
Jeshua was a priest.
Jeshua had fellow priests with him.
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Zerubbabel had associates with him.
Jeshua, Zerubbabel, the priests, and their associates began to build an altar.
The altar was for the God of Israel.
They built the altar to offer burnt offerings on it.
They did this as it is written in the Law of Moses.
Moses was the man of God.
passages.original: וַיָּקָם֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן־ יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּזְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו וַיִּבְנ֕וּ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֖ח אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ עֹל֔וֹת כַּכָּת֕וּב בְּתוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֥ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: They set up the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD—both the morning and evening burnt offerings—even though they feared the people of the land.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites had returned to their towns.
They gathered together in Jerusalem.
Jeshua son of Jozadak led the priests.
Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel led his associates.
They built the altar of the God of Israel.
They set up the altar on its foundation.
They feared the people living in the land.
Even though they were afraid, they built the altar.
They offered burnt offerings on the altar to the LORD.
They gave burnt offerings every morning.
They gave burnt offerings every evening.
passages.original: וַיָּכִ֤ינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ עַל־ מְכ֣וֹנֹתָ֔יו כִּ֚י בְּאֵימָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מֵעַמֵּ֖י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַיַּעַל עָלָ֤יו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה עֹל֖וֹת לַבֹּ֥קֶר וְלָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: They also celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles in accordance with what is written, and they offered burnt offerings daily based on the number prescribed for each day.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles.
They followed what was written in the Law of Moses.
They offered burnt offerings every day.
They gave the number of offerings required for each day.
They did this as the law commanded for each day.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־ חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּ֖וֹת כַּכָּת֑וּב וְעֹלַ֨ת י֤וֹם בְּיוֹם֙ בְּמִסְפָּ֔ר כְּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings and those for New Moons and for all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as all the freewill offerings brought to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites offered sacrifices to the LORD.
They gave regular burnt offerings.
They brought offerings for the New Moons.
They offered sacrifices for all the LORD’s appointed sacred feasts.
They also brought every freewill offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֵיכֵ֞ן עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּלְכָל־ מוֹעֲדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֑ים וּלְכֹ֛ל מִתְנַדֵּ֥ב נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: On the first day of the seventh month, the Israelites began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD, although the foundation of the temple of the LORD had not been laid.
passages.sermon: The Israelites began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD.\r\nThey started on the first day of the seventh month.\r\nThe foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
passages.original: מִיּ֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י הֵחֵ֕לּוּ לְהַעֲל֥וֹת עֹל֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וְהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יֻסָּֽד׃

passages.text: They gave money to the masons and carpenters, and food and drink and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar logs from Lebanon to Joppa by sea, as authorized by Cyrus king of Persia.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites needed materials to build the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem.
They gave money to the masons.
They gave money to the carpenters.
They gave food to the people of Sidon and Tyre.
They gave drink to the people of Sidon and Tyre.
They gave oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre.
The people of Sidon and Tyre brought cedar logs from Lebanon.
They brought the cedar logs to Joppa by sea.
Cyrus, king of Persia, gave them permission to do this.
passages.original: וַיִּ֨תְּנוּ־ כֶ֔סֶף לַחֹצְבִ֖ים וְלֶחָרָשִׁ֑ים וּמַאֲכָ֨ל וּמִשְׁתֶּ֜ה וָשֶׁ֗מֶן לַצִּֽדֹנִים֙ וְלַצֹּרִ֔ים לְהָבִיא֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֤ים מִן־ הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ אֶל־ יָ֣ם יָפ֔וֹא כְּרִשְׁי֛וֹן כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרַ֖ס עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: In the second month of the second year after they had arrived at the house of God in Jerusalem, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their associates including the priests, the Levites, and all who had returned to Jerusalem from the captivity, began the work. They appointed Levites twenty years of age or older to supervise the construction of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites returned from captivity to Jerusalem.
They came to the house of God in Jerusalem.
This happened in the second year after their return.
It was the second month of that year.
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Jeshua was the son of Jozadak.
Zerubbabel and Jeshua were leaders.
The priests and the Levites worked with them.
All the people who had returned from captivity joined them.
They began the work on the house of the LORD.
They chose Levites to supervise the work.
These Levites were twenty years old or older.
The Levites directed the construction of the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְבוֹאָ֞ם אֶל־ בֵּ֤ית הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֑י הֵחֵ֡לּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל בֶּן־ שְׁ֠אַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן־ יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וּשְׁאָ֥ר אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם׀ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם וְכָל־ הַבָּאִים֙ מֵהַשְּׁבִ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה לְנַצֵּ֖חַ עַל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: So Jeshua and his sons and brothers, Kadmiel and his sons (descendants of Yehudah), and the sons of Henadad and their sons and brothers—all Levites—joined together to supervise those working on the house of God.
passages.sermon:
Jeshua was a leader among the Levites.
Jeshua had sons and brothers.
Kadmiel was also a Levite leader.
Kadmiel had sons.
Kadmiel and his sons were descendants of Yehudah.
The sons of Henadad were Levites.
The sons of Henadad had sons and brothers.
All these Levites worked together.
They joined together as one group.
They supervised the people working on the house of God.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד יֵשׁ֡וּעַ בָּנָ֣יו וְ֠אֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵ֨ל וּבָנָ֤יו בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָה֙ כְּאֶחָ֔ד לְנַצֵּ֛חַ עַל־ עֹשֵׂ֥ה הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑יםס בְּנֵי֙ חֵֽנָדָ֔ד בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: When the builders had laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel had prescribed.
passages.sermon:
The builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD.
The priests wore their special garments.
The priests stood with trumpets.
The Levites were the sons of Asaph.
The Levites stood with cymbals.
The priests and Levites took their positions.
They praised the LORD.
David was the king of Israel.
David had given instructions for this praise.
passages.original: וְיִסְּד֥וּ הַבֹּנִ֖ים אֶת־ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים מְלֻבָּשִׁ֜ים בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֗וֹת וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־ אָסָף֙ בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֔יִם לְהַלֵּל֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ יְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And they sang responsively with praise and thanksgiving to the LORD: “For He is good; for His loving devotion to Israel endures forever.” Then all the people gave a great shout of praise to the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD had been laid.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel gathered at the site of the new temple.
They sang to the LORD.
They praised and thanked Him.
They said, “The LORD is good.”
They said, “His love for Israel lasts forever.”
All the people shouted loudly.
They praised the LORD together.
They did this because the builders had laid the foundation of the LORD’s house.
passages.original: וַֽ֠יַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּ֨ל וּבְהוֹדֹ֤ת לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם חַסְדּ֖וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכָל־ הָעָ֡ם הֵרִיעוּ֩ תְרוּעָ֙ה גְדוֹלָ֤ה בְהַלֵּל֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה עַ֖ל הוּסַ֥ד בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: But many of the older priests, Levites, and family heads who had seen the first temple wept loudly when they saw the foundation of this temple. Still, many others shouted joyfully.
passages.sermon:
Many priests were old.
Many Levites were old.
Many family leaders were old.
These old priests, Levites, and family leaders had seen the first temple.
They saw the foundation of the new temple.
They wept loudly.
Many other people shouted with joy.
passages.original: וְרַבִּ֡ים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּם֩ וְרָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָא֜וּ אֶת־ הַבַּ֤יִת הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּיָסְד֔וֹ זֶ֤ה הַבַּ֙יִת֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם בֹּכִ֖ים בְּק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְרַבִּ֛ים בִּתְרוּעָ֥ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהָרִ֥ים קֽוֹל׃

passages.text: The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping, because the people were making so much noise. And the sound was heard from afar.
passages.sermon:
The people made a very loud noise.
Some people shouted for joy.
Some people wept loudly.
The people could not tell the difference between the shouts of joy and the sounds of weeping.
The noise was so great that people heard it from far away.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣ין הָעָ֗ם מַכִּירִים֙ ק֚וֹל תְּרוּעַ֣ת הַשִּׂמְחָ֔ה לְק֖וֹל בְּכִ֣י הָעָ֑ם כִּ֣י הָעָ֗ם מְרִיעִים֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְהַקּ֥וֹל נִשְׁמַ֖ע עַד־ לְמֵרָחֽוֹק׃פ
